title: AutoScaleAI
summary: A lightweight FastAPI-based microservice that serves a pre-trained RandomForest model while simulating resource-aware auto-scaling based on latency, CPU, and memory monitoring. The only SDV-pattern hit is an unrelated substring ('sdv') inside a local file path in a pip-generated requirements.txt line, with no actual connection to the Synthetic Data Vault project.
